title: Queensland listing publication gate: licensed agent and seller disclosure readiness
disclaimer: DRAFT for review by an authorised compliance or legal owner. This pack checks that the agent has confirmed disclosure documents are ready; it does not review their content and is not legal advice.

facts.description: Listing type from the canonical model
Every listing agent is licence-verified or has an approved exception (FR-AGT-001)
Exemption from the seller disclosure regime claimed by the agent; any value other than none needs admin review
Agent confirms the Form 2 seller disclosure statement is completed and ready to give to buyers
Agent confirms the title search is ready
Lot is in a community titles scheme (body corporate)
Body corporate certificate and community management statement are ready
Property has a regulated pool (shared or non-shared)
Pool safety certificate, or notice of no pool safety certificate, is ready
Lot is on the Environmental Management Register or Contaminated Land Register
Environmental Protection Act s 408(2) notice (and any site management plan) is ready
Listing has at least one open-home time or says inspection is by appointment

rules.title: Listing agent is licence-verified
rules.failureReason: A listing agent on this property has not passed licence verification. Finish verification in Settings → Licence, or ask Landora support to review an exception.

sources.title: Landora V11 §4 Compliance gate; FR-AGT-001
sources.document: Landora Concept, Product & Delivery Document V11

rules.title: Form 2 seller disclosure statement ready
rules.failureReason: Confirm the Form 2 seller disclosure statement is completed and ready to give buyers. The law requires it before the buyer signs the contract; Landora asks for it before publishing so the listing can show as disclosure-ready.

sources.title: QLS Proctor: FAQs for seller disclosure forms
Property Law Act 2023 (Qld) Ch 7 Pt 2; Property Law Regulation 2024 s 8

assumptions: Readiness is the agent's confirmation; Landora does not review the statement's content.

rules.title: Title search ready
rules.failureReason: Confirm the title search is ready to give buyers with the Form 2.

sources.title: QLS Proctor: FAQs for seller disclosure forms (prescribed certificates, Regulation s 5)

assumptions: The full prescribed-certificate list in Property Law Regulation 2024 s 5 must be checked by the compliance owner.

rules.title: Body corporate certificate and community management statement ready
rules.failureReason: This lot is in a community titles scheme. Confirm the body corporate certificate and community management statement are ready.

sources.title: QLS Proctor: FAQs for seller disclosure forms

rules.title: Pool safety certificate or notice of no certificate ready
rules.failureReason: This property has a regulated pool. Confirm a pool safety certificate, or a notice of no pool safety certificate, is ready. Without it before contract, the buyer may be able to terminate.

sources.title: QLS Proctor: FAQs for seller disclosure forms (PLA s 104(2))

rules.title: Environmental register notice ready
rules.failureReason: This lot is on an environmental register. Confirm the Environmental Protection Act s 408(2) notice and any site management plan are ready.

sources.title: QLS Proctor: FAQs for seller disclosure forms (EP Act s 408, PLA s 104(4))

rules.title: No unreviewed disclosure exemption
rules.failureReason: An exemption from seller disclosure was claimed. Landora will review it; the listing shows without the disclosure-ready badge until confirmed.

sources.title: QLS Proctor: FAQs for seller disclosure forms (exemptions)

rules.title: Inspection times or appointment option provided
rules.failureReason: Add open-home times or mark inspections as by appointment, so buyers can add this home to their inspection timeline.

sources.title: Landora V11 FR-INSP-001
sources.document: Landora Concept, Product & Delivery Document V11

openQuestions: Decided 2026-10-28 (project lead, pending client confirmation): keep the V11 gate. Publication waits for Form 2 readiness even though the law only requires it before contract.
Does the regime apply to sales by auction in the same way? The source used does not say. Compliance owner to confirm.
Full prescribed-certificate list (Property Law Regulation 2024 s 5) to be confirmed by the compliance owner.
Source URLs for legislation point to the legislation home page; the compliance owner should replace them with exact section links.
